newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to redeem $200 mln debenture issue.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to redeem $200 mln debenture issue.

text.p: Freddie Mac said Friday that on May 20 it will redeem the entire $200 million principal amount of its 8.14 percent debenture issue.
The debentures were set to mature May 20, 2004 and have Cusip 313400J95.
They will be redeemed at a price equal to 100 percent of the principal amount.
Payment of principal plus interest accrued to the redemption date will be made to shareholders of record as of the close of business on May 19, 1997, Freddie Mac said.
Freddie Mac is a corporation chartered by Congress that buys mortgages from lenders and packages them into securities for investors.
